interface.signature: leastInterval(N: int, K: int, tasks: list[str]) -> int

preconditions.description: The number of tasks N is between 1 and 10,000 inclusive.
The cooldown period K is between 0 and 100 inclusive.
The tasks list has exactly N elements.

preconditions.expression: all('A' <= t <= 'Z' for t in tasks)
preconditions.description: Each task in the list is an uppercase English letter.

postconditions.description: The returned time is at least the number of tasks, as each task takes one unit of time.

The result is the maximum of the total tasks N and the theoretical minimum time derived from the most frequent task, where max_count is the frequency of the most frequent task and max_freq is the number of distinct tasks that share this maximum frequency.
